inherits.formula: schema_v18.json and its transitive source contract
inherits.static_bank: the complete v18 profile-specific length-two equality bank
inherits.dynamic_equality: v17 equality-closure core with fresh raw replay
inherits.meaning: no inherited mathematical constraint is removed or weakened

fixed_assignment_replay.primary: exact PB rewrite followed by audited SolverFor(QF_LRA)
fixed_assignment_replay.independent_replay: translate the frozen raw assertions into a fresh Z3 context, independently repeat the exact rewrite and QF_LRA check
fixed_assignment_replay.admission: UNSAT is blocked only when both primary and fresh replay are UNSAT and their compositional identities agree
fixed_assignment_replay.blocker: the complete 825-literal semantic assignment only; never generalized

compositional_replay_identity.explicit_nonclaim: the identity is not a raw or normalized SMT formula SHA-256
compositional_replay_identity.tamper_policy: any component, hash, or primary/replay mismatch is rejected

assignment_journal.format: one immutable JSON record file per phase in a consecutive hash chain
assignment_journal.durability: write temporary record, fsync file, atomic rename, fsync directory
assignment_journal.recovery: fail closed on malformed, nonconsecutive, hash-mismatched, or orphan outcome records
assignment_journal.blocker_record: UNSAT outcomes contain the exact projected core and blocker text/hash; SAT, UNKNOWN, and error outcomes contain no blocker

execution_guard: only one explicit case or one smoke case; broad matrix execution is rejected

terminal_status.process_exit: nonzero when the requested case is incomplete

trust_boundary: external Z3 evidence for the exact-n15 finite encoding; not a Lean theorem, kernel certificate, or universal closure result
